title: Signed sumsets and restricted signed sumsets in groups and fields
summary: Let $A = \{a_1, \ldots, a_k\}$ be a nonempty finite subset of an additive abelian group $G$. For a nonnegative integer $h$, the \emph{$h$-fold signed sumset} of $A$, denoted by $h_{\pm} A$, is defined by $$ h_{\pm} A = \Biggl\{\sum_{i = 1}^{k} λ_i a_i : λ_i \in \{-h, \ldots, h\}, \ \sum_{i = 1}^{k} |λ_i| = h \Biggr\}, $$ and the \emph{restricted $h$-fold signed sumset}, denoted by $h_{\pm}^\wedge A$, is defined by $$ h_{\pm}^\wedge A = \Biggl\{\sum_{i = 1}^{k} λ_i a_i : λ_i \in \{-1, 0, 1\}, \ \sum_{i = 1}^{k} |λ_i| = h \Biggr\}. $$ We study direct and inverse problems for these signed…
